reason: Feasible under the schedule and rules lens. (1) No new code. The exp58n build command is already in CONTEXT.md (branch-B block, 25 Sep 14:29 UTC): 12 code cells, only cells 0/4/5 differ from exp56. Both of its patches (safetail, lowrefine) are already byte-identical-when-off and fail-soft, and were dummy-gated inside K2 (16/16 plus FF 2/2). (2) The gate is achievable, and tools/dummy_gates.py already supports it via --insertion 0. divinsert is the last graph edit and returns edges only. On the local dummies, exp56 and exp57b have identical node rows once the running `id` column is stripped (sorted sha 1c94a4d40283 for both), with 17 edge-row diffs. The raw node-row sha still differs (fba489 vs 8a194c) because `id` is a global row counter, so the proposed 'node rows byte-identical to K2' gate must compare without `id`. x138 dummies are deterministic (K1 == exp57b sha). (3) Hidden runtime is about x138 (<= 6.46 h) plus lowrefine (a few s/clip), about 6.6 h: ~3 h under the 9.5 h repair deadline and ~5.4 h under the 12 h limit. It is a separate submission, so F1's runtime is unchanged. (4) Slots and latency: on 26 Sep at most 4 of 5 slots are planned (K2, K3, K3b, K4), and 27-28 Sep have spare slots (S9-S11, S13-S16). With about 7 h latency, the twin and any exp59n or F1-final-minus-insertion rebuild can be scored well before the 29 Sep 20:00 finals tick if each is submitted by 28 Sep ~12:00. It removes a scored component rather than adding a mechanism, so the 27 Sep 12:00 R8 cutoff does not bind. (5) GPU: ~5 h of quota is left before the Saturday reset after the lab shards, and the twin dummy needs 0.3-0.5 GPU-h. Three caveats, none fatal. (a) The proposed night S3 slot (26 Sep 00:30) is not covered by existing approvals: the 17:55 night plan allows only K2 plus gated K3/K3b/K4/N1, and memory says more needs a new OK. The user must approve it before sleeping, or the twin moves to the spare 26 Sep daytime slot or S9. (b) §f pre-registers F2 = exp52 unless the variant passed the E4/tempfuse gates, which the twin does not meet. §f must therefore be amended in CONTEXT.md before K2's or the twin's score is seen. The amendment should also state that a twin-vs-K2 difference of 0.001 does not reopen R2 (R7 bans choosing between near-copies on a 0.001 difference). (c) The safetail deadline path without divinsert has no dummy of its own (FD ran with divinsert). This is irrelevant at a 3 h margin; an exp58nfd dummy is optional.
fix: Build exp58n now with the existing branch-B command. Run a dummy (~0.4 GPU-h, queued after lab shard B or after the reset). Gate it with: python tools/dummy_gates.py --ref56 _dl/biohub-exp56-x138-verbatim --ref57b _dl/biohub-exp57b-x138-divins-only --k2 _dl/<exp58n> --insertion 0. Add a small diff against _dl/biohub-exp58-x138-safe-lowref: node rows equal after cut -d, -f2- (strip the id column), and edge rows differ only at K2's DIVINS insert/steal pairs. Also require no DIVINS/DEADLINE/REPAIR FAILED/LOWREFINE FAILED lines. Before any score arrives, write into CONTEXT.md §f: F2 = twin (replacing exp52) if it is error-free, public >= 0.953 and latency <= 9.5 h. Its score must not reopen R2 unless twin - K2 >= +0.002. Mirror F1 changes: build exp59n = K3 - divinsert if K3 is accepted, and F1-final minus divinsert by 28 Sep 12:00 if F1-final adds riders. Ask the user for an explicit OK to submit. Use S3 at ~00:30 26 Sep only if the OK is given before sleep; otherwise use the spare 26 Sep daytime slot, or S9 on 27 Sep.
realistic_gain: 0 on public. On private it is rank insurance: roughly +0.01 to +0.03 P(medal) over exp52 as F2 in the base case, and more if the insertion transfers badly. The claimed Monte Carlo values (0.918 -> 0.950) rest on guessed distributions and are an upper-end estimate. Cost: one idle slot, ~0.4 GPU-h, ~1 agent-hour.
